snippets.content:
# Client App
FROM johnpapa/angular-cli as client-app
LABEL authors="${1:John Papa}"
WORKDIR /usr/src/app
COPY ["package.json", "npm-shrinkwrap.json*", "./"]
RUN npm install --silent
COPY . .
RUN ng build --prod

# Node server
FROM ${2:node:12-alpine} as node-server
WORKDIR /usr/src/app
COPY ["package.json", "npm-shrinkwrap.json*", "./"]
RUN npm install --production --silent && mv node_modules ../
COPY ${3:server.js} .
COPY ${4:/server} /usr/src/app/server

# Final image
FROM ${2:node:12-alpine}
WORKDIR /usr/src/app
COPY --from=node-server /usr/src /usr/src
COPY --from=client-app /usr/src/app/dist ./
EXPOSE ${5:3000}
# CMD ["node", "server.js"]
CMD ["npm", "start"]
$0
snippets.label: Multi-stage Node and Angular Dockerfile
